interpretations: For each distinct `order_id` in `Order_Items`, average its non-NULL `product_quantity` values; subtract the average of non-NULL `product_quantity` values across all `Order_Items` rows; return results only when the overall average exists, sorted by the difference descending with NULL differences last, limited to 10 rows.
Treat NULL and blank `product_quantity` strings as missing, convert the remaining values to numbers, then calculate the per-order averages and item-weighted baseline.
queries:
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(product_quantity) AS overall_avg
  FROM Order_Items
)
SELECT
  oi.order_id,
  AVG(oi.product_quantity) - overall.overall_avg AS difference
FROM Order_Items AS oi
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE overall.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY oi.order_id
ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH item_quantities AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        CASE
            WHEN product_quantity IS NULL OR TRIM(product_quantity) = '' THEN NULL
            ELSE CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)
        END AS quantity
    FROM Order_Items
),
per_order AS (
    SELECT order_id, AVG(quantity) AS per_order_average
    FROM item_quantities
    GROUP BY order_id
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(quantity) AS item_weighted_baseline
    FROM item_quantities
)
SELECT
    o.order_id,
    p.per_order_average,
    b.item_weighted_baseline
FROM Orders AS o
LEFT JOIN per_order AS p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
